_meta.description: Quantifiable signal thresholds extracted from crypto research report for integration into crypto-ai-trader scanner system
_meta.framework: 6-dimension prediction model (macro liquidity 25%, on-chain 25%, institutional 20%, sentiment 15%, technical 10%, regulatory 5%)

scanner_factors: sentiment (8%): Per-symbol funding rate + OI changes
onchain (10%): DeFiLlama TVL changes (generic, not BTC-specific)
data_sources: Binance API (price, klines, funding rate, OI)
DeFiLlama (TVL - generic chain health, not BTC on-chain metrics)
gaps_identified: No BTC-specific on-chain metrics (MVRV, NUPL, Hash Ribbon, Puell, exchange reserves)
No global M2 / DXY macro data
F&G index uses point-in-time value, not persistence tracking

signals.name: MVRV Z-Score (BTC On-Chain)
signals.description: Market Value to Realized Value Z-Score. Marks all historical cycle bottoms with 100% accuracy.

data_source.endpoint: Glassnode: /v1/indicators/mvrv_z_score or CryptoQuant MVRV Z-Score API
data_source.alternative: Calculate from BTC Market Cap and Realized Cap (requires UTXO-level data)
data_source.auth: API key required (Glassnode free tier available)

strong_buy.expected_return: 14x-20x from bottom to next cycle top

overheat_warning.note: 2024 top was at ~2.97; top threshold has decayed from +8.8 (2017) to +7.1 (2021) to ~3.0 (2024)

signals.integration_notes: Requires new data feed module (e.g., data_feed_mvrv.py) using Glassnode or CryptoQuant API. Add as new scanner factor replacing generic DeFiLlama on-chain with BTC-specific on-chain.

new_scoring_factor.name: mvrv_zscore
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: 12% (absorbs part of current onchain 10% + gains from reduced generic TVL)

signals.name: NUPL (Net Unrealized Profit/Loss)
signals.description: Net unrealized profit/loss across all BTC holders. Negative values mark capitulation zones ~every 4 years.

capitulation_buy.historical_accuracy: Best long-term entry zone, historically ~4yr cycle

signals.integration_notes: Pair with MVRV in same data feed. NUPL is a holding-behavior indicator that remains valid in ETF era.

new_scoring_factor.name: nupl
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Combined with MVRV into single 'on_chain_valuation' factor at 12%

signals.name: Exchange Reserves (% of Supply)
signals.description: BTC held on centralized exchanges as % of circulating supply. Structural decline = bullish supply squeeze.
signals.integration_notes: Requires CryptoQuant API key. Track both absolute level and 30-day trend direction.

signals.name: Hash Ribbon (Miner Capitulation)
signals.description: 30d vs 60d hashrate MA crossover. Buy signal when 30d MA crosses back above 60d MA with positive price momentum. Historically strongest single on-chain buy signal.

data_source.endpoint: Hash Ribbons API or compute from hashrate data

buy_signal.historical_accuracy: 64% of signals profitable (9/14 since 2013), avg return >5000% to cycle top

signals.integration_notes: Requires hashrate data (available from blockchain.com or Glassnode). This is a BTC-global signal, not per-symbol. Use as market-wide modifier.

new_scoring_factor.name: hash_ribbon
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Market-wide modifier (not per-symbol), adds +5 to all scores when buy signal active

signals.name: Puell Multiple
signals.description: Ratio of daily miner revenue to 365-day average. Measures supply-side profitability.

green_zone_buy.historical_accuracy: Correctly identified all major bottoms since 2011

red_zone_caution.note: Post-2024 halving, threshold decaying: was >8 (2013), >5 (2017), >3 (2021+). Conservative: reduce exposure above 2.0-2.5

signals.integration_notes: BTC-global signal. Pair with Hash Ribbon for strongest combo: Hash Ribbon buy + Puell < 0.5 + MVRV Z < 0 = triple confirmation (92.1% accuracy).

signals.name: Stablecoin Supply Growth
signals.description: Total stablecoin market cap 30-day change. Leads BTC price 10-45 days via Granger causality (F-stat significant at 1-5%).

bullish_accumulation.historical_accuracy: 80% probability of 20%+ BTC rally within 6 weeks

strong_institutional.historical_accuracy: 85%+ probability, high correlation with institutional capital deployment

signals.integration_notes: Requires new data feed. CoinGecko free API can track USDT+USDC+DAI+FDUSD market cap over time. Cache daily snapshots, compute 30d rolling change.

signals.name: SSR (Stablecoin Supply Ratio) Oscillator
signals.description: BTC market cap / total stablecoin market cap. Oscillator measures deviation from mean. Low SSR = high stablecoin buying power (dry powder).

data_source.provider: Self-calculated from BTC market cap + stablecoin supply data

triple_negative_resonance.note: Only 238 instances in 2919 days, marks major accumulation windows

signals.integration_notes: Calculated from stablecoin supply + BTC market cap. Needs 90d/200d/365d oscillator computation. Combine with SIG-006.

new_scoring_factor.name: ssr_oscillator
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Combined with stablecoin supply into 'liquidity_purchasing_power' factor at 10%

signals.name: ETF Daily Net Flows (5-Day Persistence)
signals.description: Daily net inflows/outflows of US spot Bitcoin ETFs. 5+ consecutive days of >$200M daily inflow = strongest institutional signal.

data_source.endpoint: SoSoValue API: https://api.sosovalue.com/btc/etf-flows or Farside daily CSV
data_source.alternative: Scrape Bloomberg terminal or use free aggregators

strong_bullish.note: Reflects structural institutional allocation, not short-term arbitrage

signals.integration_notes: Requires new data feed. SoSoValue or Farside Investors provide daily data. This is BTC-global signal, modify all BTC-pair scores.

new_scoring_factor.name: etf_flows
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Market-wide modifier: +10 when 5d avg > $200M inflow, -10 when 5d avg > $200M outflow

scoring_logic.strongly_bullish: 5d avg > $200M inflow + 5+ consecutive inflow days → +10 modifier

signals.name: CFGI Persistence (Fear Duration)
signals.description: Crypto Fear & Greed Index duration at extreme fear levels. Single-day fear is noise; 10+ consecutive days below 25 = bottom signal.

bottom_signal.note: Institutional era adjustment: threshold raised from <20 to <25

signals.integration_notes: Current system fetches F&G value but only uses point-in-time. NEED: Track history in SQLite, compute consecutive days below/above threshold. The fng_history table already stores 30 days of history. Modify MarketSentimentAgent to check persistence duration.

modification_needed.change: Accept fng_history list (30d), compute consecutive_days_below_25. If >= 10, score jumps to 90+.
Expose get_consecutive_days_below(threshold=25) method using existing fng_history table

signals.name: Funding Rate Persistence (30d Average)
signals.description: 30-day average funding rate. Sustained negative funding = strongest contrarian buy signal (83-96% win rate 30-360d).

strongest_bullish.note: Current data: 67 consecutive days negative (record since 2026)

bullish.note: 78% probability of major price surge (Octagon AI data)

signals.integration_notes: Current SentimentAgent uses point-in-time funding rate. NEED: Store 30-day funding rate history, compute rolling average. Funding rate data feed exists but only fetches last 24 entries.

modification_needed.change: Add get_30d_average() method that computes rolling 30d average from cached history. Store daily snapshots in SQLite.
Accept funding_30d_avg parameter. When < -0.01%, boost score to 85+. When > +0.1% sustained, penalize.

signals.name: Global M2 Money Supply Direction
signals.description: Global M2 growth rate direction. M2 expansion leads BTC by 8-10 weeks with 0.78 correlation (0.94 at 180d rolling peak).

data_source.alternative: Calculate from central bank balance sheet data

bearish_macro.note: M2 contraction preceded every BTC bear market since 2014

signals.integration_notes: Requires new data feed (data_feed_macro.py). FRED API provides monthly US M2 (M2SL) and global M2 (WM2NS). Monthly frequency means this is a regime-level modifier, not per-scan input.

new_scoring_factor.name: macro_m2
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Market-wide regime modifier: +8 when M2 growth turning positive, -8 when turning negative

signals.name: DXY (US Dollar Index) Trend
signals.description: US Dollar Index level and trend. DXY < 97-98 historically coincides with strongest BTC rallies. BTC-DXY 90d correlation reaches -0.70.

bullish_for_btc.note: Strongest BTC rallies historically coincide with DXY below 97-98

signals.integration_notes: Daily data from free APIs. Combine with M2 into macro data feed. BTC-global signal.

new_scoring_factor.name: dxy_trend
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Part of macro modifier combined with M2

signals.name: BTC-SPX 90d Rolling Correlation
signals.description: Bitcoin-S&P 500 correlation. Post-ETF structural break: from ~0 to 0.87-0.92. High correlation = BTC is a risk asset, not safe haven.

data_source.provider: Calculate from BTC daily returns + SPX daily returns

risk_on_regime.note: BTC trades as pure risk asset; monitor SPX for direction

divergence_opportunity.note: BTC decoupling from equities = potential independent rally

signals.integration_notes: Calculated signal. Need SPX data feed. Primarily used for regime detection, not direct trade signal.

new_scoring_factor.name: btc_spx_correlation
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Regime modifier: when corr > 0.85, apply SPX trend as additional filter

scoring_logic.risk_on_aligned: High corr + SPX trending up → neutral (follow market)
scoring_logic.risk_on_diverge: High corr + SPX trending down → bearish modifier

signals.name: Put/Call Ratio (BTC Options)
signals.description: BTC options put/call ratio. High P/C ratio = excess hedging = contrarian bullish.

contrarian_bullish.note: Needs confirmation with implied volatility term structure

signals.integration_notes: Requires Deribit or Laevitas API. BTC-specific options data. Good for sentiment confirmation.

signals.name: Long/Short Ratio (Perpetual Futures)
signals.description: Ratio of long to short positions in perpetual futures. Extreme short crowding = contrarian bullish.
signals.integration_notes: Binance public endpoint, no auth needed. Per-symbol ratio available.

signals.name: Multi-Dimension Resonance Score
signals.description: Count of dimensions showing same-direction signal. 4+ bullish = 72% rally probability. 5+ = 85%. 6 = 92%.

data_source.description: Aggregate from all individual dimension scores

signals.integration_notes: This is the TOP-LEVEL aggregation of the entire framework. Requires all other signals to be implemented first. This is the ultimate scoring system described in Chapter 8 of the report.

scoring_design.composite_formula: resonance_score = sum(1 for d in dimensions if d.direction == 'bullish')

signals.name: Regulatory Event Detection
signals.description: Asymmetric impact of regulatory events: positive +1.52% avg, negative -3.12% avg. Bans can cause -24% median.

data_source.provider: CryptoCompare News API (already implemented) + LLM classification
data_source.enhancement: Add NLP classification for regulatory keywords (SEC, CFTC, ban, approval, GENIUS, CLARITY, ETF decision)

positive_regulatory_signal.note: Structural positives (GENIUS Act, CLARITY Act) have longer-term impact

signals.integration_notes: Enhance existing news feed with regulatory classification. Use keyword detection or LLM classification. Primarily risk management input.

new_scoring_factor.name: regulatory_sentiment
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Market-wide risk modifier: -10 when major negative event detected

signals.name: BTC-Gold 90d Correlation
signals.description: BTC-Gold correlation exceeded 92% in 2025 with ~40 day lag. Indicates BTC is being re-rated as digital gold.

data_source.provider: Calculate from BTC + Gold (GLD or XAUUSD) daily returns
inputs: Gold daily close (Yahoo: GC=F or GLD)

digital_gold_narrative.note: Institutional re-rating of BTC as macro asset

signals.integration_notes: Auxiliary macro signal. Primarily for regime understanding. Can share implementation with SIG-013.

new_scoring_factor.name: btc_gold_correlation
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Regime context only (no direct scoring weight)
new_scoring_factor.scoring_logic: Informational: high gold correlation = institutional macro asset regime

signals.name: Whale Accumulation Signal
signals.description: Large wallet (>100 BTC and >1000 BTC) accumulation patterns. 270k BTC accumulated in 30 days during March 2026 extreme fear.

data_source.endpoint: CryptoQuant: Exchange Whale Ratio or Glassnode: Supply Distribution

massive_accumulation.note: 13-year record monthly net buying in March 2026

accumulation.note: Wallets with >100 BTC exceeded 20,000 for first time

distribution_warning.note: Large deposits to exchange = potential sell pressure

signals.integration_notes: BTC-global signal. Requires CryptoQuant API. Pair with exchange reserves for supply-side picture.

new_scoring_factor.name: whale_accumulation
new_scoring_factor.weight_suggestion: Market-wide modifier: +5 when accumulation phase confirmed

signals.name: Google Trends 'Crypto' Search Volume
signals.description: Google search interest for 'crypto'. Extremely low values (<25/100) indicate retail capitulation = contrarian signal.

data_source.provider: Google Trends (pytrends library) / Google Trends API
data_source.note: Not a leading indicator; synchronous or lagging. Only useful at extremes.

retail_capitulation.note: Retail interest near zero = 'last retail has left' = bottom conditions

retail_euphoria.note: Retail FOMO typically follows price, marking late-cycle

signals.integration_notes: Low prediction value per report. Use only as auxiliary confirmation. Google Trends API has rate limits.

phase_1_critical.description: P0 signals that dramatically improve the scanner's predictive power

phase_2_structural.description: P1 signals adding institutional and supply-side data

phase_3_macro_composite.description: P2 signals and the multi-dimension resonance framework

scanner_weight_rebalance.note: The report recommends on_chain=25% + liquidity=25% + macro=20% + sentiment=15% + technical=10% + regulatory=5% at the macro framework level, but per-symbol scanning needs more granular factors.
